name: Google Search Ads 360
shortInfo: Google Search Ads 360 is a search management platform.
brief: Google Search Ads 360 is a search management platform that allows advertisers to manage and optimize their paid search campaigns across multiple search engines from a single interface.
about: Google Search Ads 360 Connector enables streaming relevant Google Search Ads 360 data into a user determined data warehouse. Reporting on various performance metrics relevant to the advertisement forms an integral part of most Advertisement applications.This sync happens in an automated manner after a user has configured relevant pipelines and determined an update frequency.
